id-20261115-news-1.title: Red and White Village Cooperative: How to Read the Business Model, Capital Sources, and Non-Performing Loan Risks for Village Residents

segments.src: Koperasi Desa Merah Putih digadang-gadang sebagai salah satu program andalan untuk menggerakkan ekonomi perdesaan.
segments.tr: The Red and White Village Cooperative is touted as one of the mainstay programs to drive the rural economy.

segments.src: Gagasannya sederhana: setiap desa atau kelurahan memiliki lembaga usaha bersama yang dikelola warga, sehingga perputaran uang tidak terus-menerus mengalir keluar desa.
segments.tr: The idea is simple: every village or sub-district has a joint business entity managed by residents, so that the circulation of money does not continually flow out of the village.

segments.src: Namun, program sebesar ini tidak otomatis berhasil hanya karena badan hukumnya berdiri.
segments.tr: However, a program this large does not automatically succeed just because its legal entity is established.

segments.src: Artikel ini membantu warga, anggota, dan calon pengurus memahami cara kerjanya dengan kepala dingin.
segments.tr: This article helps residents, members, and prospective administrators understand how it works with a cool head.

segments.src: > Catatan: Rincian kebijakan, aturan teknis, dan angka pembiayaan dapat berubah. Periksa informasi terbaru dari kementerian terkait, pemerintah daerah, atau dinas koperasi setempat sebelum mengambil keputusan.
segments.tr: > Note: Policy details, technical rules, and financing figures are subject to change. Check the latest information from the relevant ministry, local government, or local cooperative office before making a decision.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu Koperasi Desa Merah Putih?
segments.tr: ## What Is the Red and White Village Cooperative?

segments.src: Secara umum, Koperasi Desa Merah Putih adalah koperasi yang dibentuk di tingkat desa atau kelurahan untuk menjadi wadah kegiatan ekonomi warga.
segments.tr: In general, the Red and White Village Cooperative is a cooperative formed at the village or sub-district level to serve as a hub for residents' economic activities.

segments.src: Gerai atau unit usahanya dirancang mencakup kebutuhan sehari-hari, misalnya:
segments.tr: Its outlets or business units are designed to cover daily needs, for example:

segments.src: - penyediaan sembako dan kebutuhan pokok;
segments.tr: - provision of basic necessities and staple goods;

segments.src: - penyaluran pupuk, bibit, dan sarana pertanian;
segments.tr: - distribution of fertilizer, seeds, and agricultural facilities;

segments.src: - simpan pinjam bagi anggota;
segments.tr: - savings and loan services for members;

segments.src: - layanan logistik dan pemasaran hasil panen;
segments.tr: - logistics and harvest marketing services;

segments.src: - unit usaha lain sesuai potensi desa, seperti klinik, apotek, atau pergudangan.
segments.tr: - other business units according to village potential, such as clinics, pharmacies, or warehousing.

segments.src: Sebagai koperasi, prinsip dasarnya tetap sama: keanggotaan bersifat sukarela, pengelolaan demokratis (satu anggota satu suara), dan sisa hasil usaha (SHU) dibagikan sesuai jasa anggota, bukan sesuai besarnya modal semata.
segments.tr: As a cooperative, the basic principles remain the same: membership is voluntary, management is democratic (one member, one vote), and remaining business surplus (SHU) is distributed according to member services, not solely based on the amount of capital.

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Model Bisnisnya
segments.tr: ## How to Read Its Business Model

segments.src: Untuk menilai apakah sebuah koperasi sehat, lihat dari mana pendapatannya datang dan ke mana uangnya pergi.
segments.tr: To assess whether a cooperative is healthy, look at where its revenue comes from and where its money goes.

segments.src: ### 1. Sumber pendapatan
segments.tr: ### 1. Sources of revenue

segments.src: - **Margin penjualan barang.** Koperasi membeli dari pemasok atau produsen dalam jumlah besar, lalu menjual ke anggota dan warga dengan margin tipis.
segments.tr: - **Goods sales margin.** The cooperative buys from suppliers or producers in large quantities, then sells to members and residents with a thin margin.

segments.src: - **Bunga atau jasa simpan pinjam.** Pendapatan dari pinjaman anggota, dengan syarat penyalurannya hati-hati.
segments.tr: - **Savings and loan interest or fees.** Revenue from member loans, provided disbursement is done carefully.

segments.src: - **Jasa layanan.** Misalnya pengangkutan, penggilingan, pembayaran tagihan, atau penjualan produk digital.
segments.tr: - **Service fees.** For example, transportation, milling, bill payments, or sales of digital products.

segments.src: - **Hasil olahan dan pemasaran produk desa.** Nilai tambah dari produk pertanian, perikanan, atau kerajinan.
segments.tr: - **Processed products and marketing of village products.** Added value from agricultural, fishery, or handicraft products.

segments.src: ### 2. Pos biaya
segments.tr: ### 2. Cost items

segments.src: Biaya yang sering luput dihitung antara lain gaji pengelola, sewa atau penyusutan gedung, listrik, transportasi, kehilangan stok, dan biaya penagihan.
segments.tr: Costs often overlooked in calculations include manager salaries, building rent or depreciation, electricity, transportation, stock loss, and collection costs.

segments.src: Koperasi yang hanya melihat omzet tanpa menghitung biaya bisa tampak ramai, tetapi sebenarnya merugi.
segments.tr: A cooperative that only looks at turnover without calculating costs may seem busy, but is actually operating at a loss.

segments.src: ### 3. Pertanyaan kunci
segments.tr: ### 3. Key questions

segments.src: 1. Apakah unit usaha utamanya benar-benar dibutuhkan warga?
segments.tr: 1. Are its main business units truly needed by the residents?

segments.src: 2. Apakah ada pesaing, seperti warung atau toko yang sudah mapan, dan apa keunggulan koperasi?
segments.tr: 2. Are there competitors, such as established stalls or shops, and what is the cooperative's advantage?

segments.src: 3. Apakah pengelola punya kemampuan membuat pembukuan yang rapi?
segments.tr: 3. Do the managers have the ability to maintain neat bookkeeping?

segments.src: 4. Apakah rencana usaha realistis terhadap jumlah penduduk dan daya beli desa?
segments.tr: 4. Is the business plan realistic regarding the population and purchasing power of the village?

segments.src: ## Dari Mana Modalnya?
segments.tr: ## Where Does the Capital Come From?

segments.src: Modal koperasi umumnya berasal dari beberapa lapis:
segments.tr: Cooperative capital generally comes from several layers:

segments.src: - **Simpanan pokok dan simpanan wajib anggota.** Fondasi modal sendiri dan cerminan rasa memiliki.
segments.tr: - **Principal savings and mandatory member savings.** The foundation of own capital and a reflection of a sense of ownership.

segments.src: - **Simpanan sukarela dan cadangan dari SHU.** Memperkuat permodalan secara bertahap.
segments.tr: - **Voluntary savings and reserves from SHU.** Strengthening capitalization gradually.

segments.src: - **Dana desa.** Dalam skema yang dibahas pemerintah, dana desa dapat berperan sebagai sumber pembayaran atau penjamin cicilan pembiayaan, sesuai aturan yang berlaku. Dana desa tetap uang publik, sehingga penggunaannya harus melalui musyawarah desa dan dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.
segments.tr: - **Village funds.** In the scheme discussed by the government, village funds can act as a source of payment or guarantor of financing installments, according to applicable regulations. Village funds remain public money, so their use must go through village deliberation and be accountable.

segments.src: - **Pembiayaan dari bank.** Bank-bank milik negara disebut sebagai penyalur pembiayaan. Pinjaman berarti kewajiban yang harus dikembalikan beserta bunga atau marginnya.
segments.tr: - **Bank financing.** State-owned banks are referred to as financing distributors. Loans mean obligations that must be repaid along with interest or margins.

segments.src: - **Hibah atau dukungan program.** Bantuan dari pemerintah pusat, daerah, atau mitra lain, biasanya dengan syarat pelaporan.
segments.tr: - **Grants or program support.** Assistance from the central government, local government, or other partners, usually with reporting requirements.

segments.src: Poin penting: **pembiayaan bukan hadiah.** Semakin besar porsi utang dibandingkan modal sendiri, semakin besar tekanan untuk menghasilkan arus kas yang stabil setiap bulan.
segments.tr: Important point: **financing is not a gift.** The greater the portion of debt compared to own capital, the greater the pressure to generate stable cash flow every month.

segments.src: ## Peran Dana Desa dan Bank
segments.tr: ## The Role of Village Funds and Banks

segments.src: Dana desa selama ini dipakai untuk pembangunan infrastruktur, pemberdayaan, dan layanan dasar.
segments.tr: Village funds have so far been used for infrastructure development, empowerment, and basic services.

segments.src: Jika sebagian dialokasikan untuk mendukung koperasi, ada dua hal yang perlu diperhatikan warga:
segments.tr: If a portion is allocated to support the cooperative, there are two things residents need to note:

segments.src: - **Biaya peluang.** Dana yang terikat untuk cicilan berarti berkurang untuk kegiatan lain, seperti jalan desa, posyandu, atau irigasi.
segments.tr: - **Opportunity cost.** Funds tied up for installments mean less for other activities, such as village roads, posyandu (integrated health posts), or irrigation.

segments.src: - **Transparansi.** Warga berhak tahu berapa besar dana yang dialokasikan, untuk apa, dan bagaimana hasilnya dilaporkan dalam musyawarah desa.
segments.tr: - **Transparency.** Residents have the right to know how much funds are allocated, for what purpose, and how the results are reported in village deliberations.

segments.src: Bank, di sisi lain, tetap menilai kelayakan usaha.
segments.tr: Banks, on the other hand, still assess business feasibility.

segments.src: Rencana bisnis yang jelas, pembukuan yang tertib, dan pengurus yang kredibel akan sangat menentukan kelancaran pembiayaan.
segments.tr: A clear business plan, orderly bookkeeping, and credible management will greatly determine smooth financing.

segments.src: ## Risiko Kredit Macet dan Cara Mengenalinya
segments.tr: ## Risks of Non-Performing Loans and How to Recognize Them

segments.src: Kredit macet terjadi ketika cicilan tidak dibayar dalam waktu lama.
segments.tr: Non-performing loans occur when installments are not paid for a long time.

segments.src: Pada koperasi desa, risikonya bisa datang dari dua arah: dari koperasi kepada bank, dan dari anggota kepada koperasi.
segments.tr: In village cooperatives, the risk can come from two directions: from the cooperative to the bank, and from members to the cooperative.

segments.src: ### Penyebab yang sering muncul
segments.tr: ### Frequent causes

segments.src: - **Usaha tidak sesuai kebutuhan pasar**, sehingga omzet tidak menutup cicilan.
segments.tr: - **Businesses do not match market needs**, so turnover does not cover installments.

segments.src: - **Pinjaman diberikan tanpa analisis memadai**, misalnya karena hubungan kekerabatan.
segments.tr: - **Loans are given without adequate analysis**, for example due to kinship ties.

segments.src: - **Pencampuran uang pribadi dan uang koperasi.**
segments.tr: - **Mixing personal money and cooperative money.**

segments.src: - **Pembukuan lemah**, sehingga masalah baru terlihat saat sudah besar.
segments.tr: - **Weak bookkeeping**, so problems are only seen when they are big.

segments.src: - **Ketergantungan pada satu komoditas** yang harganya naik turun, seperti sawit, kopi, atau padi.
segments.tr: - **Dependency on a single commodity** whose price fluctuates, such as palm oil, coffee, or rice.

segments.src: - **Gagal panen atau bencana**, tanpa cadangan dana.
segments.tr: - **Crop failure or disasters**, without fund reserves.

segments.src: - **Intervensi pihak tertentu** dalam penentuan pengurus atau penerima pinjaman.
segments.tr: - **Intervention by certain parties** in determining management or loan recipients.

segments.src: ### Tanda peringatan dini
segments.tr: ### Early warning signs

segments.src: - Cicilan anggota mulai sering tertunda.
segments.tr: - Member installments frequently begin to be delayed.

segments.src: - Stok barang tidak sesuai catatan.
segments.tr: - Stock goods do not match records.

segments.src: - Laporan keuangan terlambat atau tidak dibuka kepada anggota.
segments.tr: - Financial reports are late or not opened to members.

segments.src: - Rapat Anggota Tahunan (RAT) tidak diadakan atau sepi.
segments.tr: - Annual Member Meetings (RAT) are not held or have low attendance.

segments.src: - Pengurus mengambil keputusan besar tanpa musyawarah.
segments.tr: - Management makes major decisions without deliberation.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Dicermati Anggota
segments.tr: ## What Members Need to Pay Attention To

segments.src: 1. **Pahami hak dan kewajiban.** Anggota berhak atas informasi, suara dalam RAT, dan SHU.
segments.tr: 1. **Understand rights and obligations.** Members are entitled to information, a vote in the RAT, and SHU.

segments.src: 2. **Hadiri RAT dan ajukan pertanyaan.** Minta laporan neraca, laba rugi, dan daftar pinjaman bermasalah.
segments.tr: 2. **Attend the RAT and ask questions.** Request balance sheets, income statements, and lists of troubled loans.

segments.src: 3. **Jangan meminjam melebihi kemampuan bayar.** Hitung cicilan terhadap penghasilan bulanan.
segments.tr: 3. **Do not borrow beyond repayment capacity.** Calculate installments against monthly income.

segments.src: 4. **Belanja di koperasi** jika harganya wajar, agar perputaran usaha terjaga.
segments.tr: 4. **Shop at the cooperative** if prices are reasonable, to maintain business circulation.

segments.src: 5. **Awasi penggunaan dana.** Laporkan dugaan penyimpangan melalui mekanisme internal, pengawas koperasi, atau dinas terkait.
segments.tr: 5. **Supervise the use of funds.** Report suspected deviations through internal mechanisms, cooperative supervisors, or related agencies.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Dicermati Pengurus
segments.tr: ## What Management Needs to Pay Attention To

segments.src: 1. **Mulai dari yang kecil dan terukur.** Satu atau dua unit usaha yang kuat lebih baik daripada banyak unit yang setengah jalan.
segments.tr: 1. **Start small and measurable.** One or two strong business units are better than many half-way units.

segments.src: 2. **Pisahkan keuangan** koperasi dari keuangan pribadi dan keuangan desa.
segments.tr: 2. **Separate cooperative finances** from personal finances and village finances.

segments.src: 3. **Terapkan prinsip kehati-hatian dalam pinjaman:** verifikasi usaha, batasi plafon, dan tetapkan jaminan atau mekanisme tanggung renteng yang wajar.
segments.tr: 3. **Apply prudential principles in loans:** verify businesses, limit ceilings, and establish reasonable collateral or joint-liability mechanisms.

segments.src: 4. **Gunakan pembukuan yang tertib**, bila perlu dengan aplikasi sederhana, dan publikasikan ringkasannya.
segments.tr: 4. **Use orderly bookkeeping**, if necessary with simple applications, and publish summaries.

segments.src: 5. **Tingkatkan kapasitas.** Ikuti pelatihan manajemen, akuntansi, dan literasi digital.
segments.tr: 5. **Enhance capacity.** Take training in management, accounting, and digital literacy.

segments.src: 6. **Siapkan dana cadangan** untuk menghadapi musim paceklik atau lonjakan pinjaman bermasalah.
segments.tr: 6. **Prepare reserve funds** to face lean seasons or surges in troubled loans.

segments.src: 7. **Jaga independensi.** Keputusan harus berpijak pada kepentingan anggota, bukan tekanan pihak luar.
segments.tr: 7. **Maintain independence.** Decisions must be based on the interests of members, not external pressures.

segments.src: ## Agar Koperasi Tidak Mandek
segments.tr: ## To Keep the Cooperative from Stalling

segments.src: Banyak koperasi di masa lalu berhenti beroperasi bukan karena kurang modal, melainkan karena lemahnya tata kelola, kurangnya partisipasi anggota, dan usaha yang tidak sesuai kebutuhan.
segments.tr: Many cooperatives in the past stopped operating not because of a lack of capital, but because of weak governance, lack of member participation, and businesses that did not match needs.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah praktis:
segments.tr: Several practical steps:

segments.src: - lakukan **pemetaan potensi desa** sebelum memilih unit usaha;
segments.tr: - conduct **village potential mapping** before choosing a business unit;

segments.src: - bangun **kemitraan** dengan petani, UMKM lokal, dan pemasok yang andal;
segments.tr: - build **partnerships** with farmers, local MSMEs, and reliable suppliers;

segments.src: - gunakan **teknologi sederhana** untuk pencatatan dan pembayaran;
segments.tr: - use **simple technology** for recording and payments;

segments.src: - tetapkan **indikator kinerja**, misalnya omzet bulanan, rasio pinjaman macet, dan jumlah anggota aktif;
segments.tr: - set **performance indicators**, such as monthly turnover, non-performing loan ratios, and the number of active members;

segments.src: - lakukan **evaluasi berkala** dan berani menutup unit usaha yang terus merugi.
segments.tr: - conduct **periodic evaluations** and have the courage to close business units that continue to lose money.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Koperasi Desa Merah Putih menyimpan peluang besar, terutama jika dikelola secara profesional, terbuka, dan berpihak pada anggota.
segments.tr: The Red and White Village Cooperative holds great opportunities, especially if managed professionally, openly, and in favor of members.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, ia membawa risiko nyata, khususnya bila pembiayaan besar tidak diimbangi usaha yang layak dan pengawasan yang kuat.
segments.tr: On the other hand, it carries real risks, especially if large financing is not balanced with feasible businesses and strong supervision.

segments.src: Warga yang paham cara membaca model bisnis, sumber modal, dan tanda-tanda kredit bermasalah akan lebih siap menjadi pengawas sekaligus penggerak koperasinya.
segments.tr: Residents who understand how to read business models, capital sources, and signs of troubled credit will be better prepared to become supervisors as well as drivers of their cooperative.

segments.src: *Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat keuangan atau hukum.
segments.tr: *This article is for general information purposes and is not financial or legal advice.

segments.src: Untuk keputusan menyangkut pinjaman, investasi, atau penggunaan dana desa, konsultasikan dengan dinas koperasi, pendamping desa, atau penasihat profesional yang berwenang.*
segments.tr: For decisions concerning loans, investments, or the use of village funds, consult with the cooperative service, village companion, or authorized professional advisors.*

id-20261115-news-2.title: The Criminal Procedure Code Bill and Suspect Rights: A Guide to Understanding Changes in Criminal Procedure Law and Citizen Protection

segments.src: Hukum acara pidana sering terdengar jauh dari kehidupan sehari-hari.
segments.tr: Criminal procedural law often sounds distant from everyday life.

segments.src: Padahal aturan ini menentukan **bagaimana** seseorang diperiksa, ditangkap, ditahan, dan diadili.
segments.tr: In fact, these rules determine **how** a person is investigated, arrested, detained, and tried.

segments.src: Karena itu pembaruan Kitab Undang-Undang Hukum Acara Pidana (KUHAP) layak dipahami oleh warga biasa, bukan hanya oleh praktisi hukum.
segments.tr: Therefore, the reform of the Criminal Procedure Code (KUHAP) is worth understanding by ordinary citizens, not just legal practitioners.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat hukum. Proses pembahasan dan isi pasal dapat berubah atau sudah diperbarui, jadi selalu cek naskah terbaru dari sumber resmi.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is for general information and does not constitute legal advice. The discussion process and article contents may change or have been updated, so always check the latest text from official sources.

segments.src: ## Mengapa KUHAP Perlu Diperbarui?
segments.tr: ## Why Does KUHAP Need to Be Updated?

segments.src: KUHAP yang berlaku selama ini lahir pada 1981.
segments.tr: The KUHAP that has been in effect was born in 1981.

segments.src: Sejak itu banyak hal berubah: teknologi, bentuk kejahatan, standar hak asasi manusia, serta harapan masyarakat terhadap proses peradilan yang transparan.
segments.tr: Since then, many things have changed: technology, forms of crime, human rights standards, and public expectations for a transparent judicial process.

segments.src: Pembaruan juga berkaitan dengan penerapan KUHP nasional yang baru, sehingga hukum pidana materiil dan hukum acaranya perlu selaras.
segments.tr: The reform is also related to the implementation of the new national Criminal Code (KUHP), so that material criminal law and its procedural law need to be aligned.

segments.src: Secara umum, tujuan yang sering disebut dalam pembahasan pembaruan ini antara lain:
segments.tr: In general, the goals frequently mentioned in this reform discussion include:

segments.src: - menyesuaikan prosedur dengan perkembangan zaman;
segments.tr: - adjusting procedures to the developments of the times;

segments.src: - memperkuat perlindungan hak tersangka, terdakwa, saksi, dan korban;
segments.tr: - strengthening the protection of the rights of suspects, defendants, witnesses, and victims;

segments.src: - memperjelas pembagian peran antarlembaga penegak hukum;
segments.tr: - clarifying the division of roles among law enforcement agencies;

segments.src: - mendorong proses yang lebih akuntabel dan terdokumentasi.
segments.tr: - encouraging a more accountable and documented process.

segments.src: ## Siapa Saja yang Terlibat dalam Proses Pidana?
segments.tr: ## Who Is Involved in the Criminal Process?

segments.src: Agar mudah mengikuti berita, kenali dulu para pihak utama:
segments.tr: To easily follow the news, get to know the main parties first:

segments.src: | Pihak | Peran umum |
segments.tr: | Party | General role |

segments.src: | Penyelidik dan penyidik | Mencari dan mengumpulkan bukti, memeriksa pihak terkait |
segments.tr: | Investigators and assistant investigators | Finding and collecting evidence, examining related parties |

segments.src: | Penuntut umum (jaksa) | Menyusun dakwaan dan menuntut di pengadilan |
segments.tr: | Public prosecutor (prosecutor) | Drafting the indictment and prosecuting in court |

segments.src: | Hakim | Memeriksa perkara dan memutus |
segments.tr: | Judge | Examining the case and deciding |

segments.src: | Advokat (pengacara) | Mendampingi dan membela kepentingan hukum klien |
segments.tr: | Advocate (lawyer) | Assisting and defending the client's legal interests |

segments.src: | Tersangka/terdakwa | Pihak yang diduga atau didakwa melakukan tindak pidana |
segments.tr: | Suspect/defendant | The party suspected or charged with committing a criminal offense |

segments.src: | Saksi dan korban | Pihak yang memberi keterangan dan memiliki kepentingan atas perkara |
segments.tr: | Witness and victim | Parties who provide information and have an interest in the case |

segments.src: ## Isu Utama yang Paling Berdampak bagi Warga
segments.tr: ## Key Issues That Most Impact Citizens

segments.src: ### 1. Penangkapan dan penahanan
segments.tr: ### 1. Arrest and detention

segments.src: Penangkapan dan penahanan membatasi kebebasan seseorang, sehingga syarat dan prosedurnya harus jelas.
segments.tr: Arrest and detention limit a person's freedom, so the requirements and procedures must be clear.

segments.src: Hal yang biasanya diperhatikan:
segments.tr: Things usually paid attention to:

segments.src: - adanya surat perintah dan penjelasan alasan;
segments.tr: - the existence of an arrest warrant and an explanation of reasons;

segments.src: - batas waktu yang tegas;
segments.tr: - strict time limits;

segments.src: - pemberitahuan kepada keluarga;
segments.tr: - notification to the family;

segments.src: - mekanisme pengujian jika prosedur dianggap tidak sah, misalnya melalui praperadilan.
segments.tr: - review mechanisms if procedures are deemed invalid, for example through pre-trial.

segments.src: Dalam diskusi publik, pertanyaan yang sering muncul adalah seberapa ketat syarat objektif dan subjektif penahanan, serta bagaimana pengawasannya.
segments.tr: In public discussions, questions that often arise are how strict the objective and subjective requirements for detention are, and how they are monitored.

segments.src: ### 2. Pendampingan hukum
segments.tr: ### 2. Legal assistance

segments.src: Hak atas bantuan hukum adalah salah satu pilar peradilan yang adil.
segments.tr: The right to legal aid is one of the pillars of a fair trial.

segments.src: Pembaruan KUHAP banyak dibahas dari sisi peran advokat, misalnya:
segments.tr: KUHAP reform is widely discussed from the perspective of the advocate's role, for example:

segments.src: - hak didampingi sejak tahap pemeriksaan awal;
segments.tr: - the right to be accompanied from the initial examination stage;

segments.src: - hak berkomunikasi dengan penasihat hukum;
segments.tr: - the right to communicate with legal counsel;

segments.src: - kewajiban negara menyediakan bantuan hukum bagi yang tidak mampu pada kondisi tertentu.
segments.tr: - the state's obligation to provide legal aid for those who cannot afford it under certain conditions.

segments.src: Bagi warga, pesan praktisnya sederhana: Anda berhak mengetahui hak Anda sebelum memberi keterangan.
segments.tr: For citizens, the practical message is simple: You have the right to know your rights before giving a statement.

segments.src: ### 3. Asas praduga tak bersalah
segments.tr: ### 3. Presumption of innocence

segments.src: Seseorang dianggap tidak bersalah sampai ada putusan pengadilan yang berkekuatan hukum tetap.
segments.tr: A person is considered innocent until there is a court decision with permanent legal force.

segments.src: Prinsip ini berdampak pada cara aparat dan media menyampaikan informasi perkara, serta pada perlakuan terhadap tersangka selama proses berjalan.
segments.tr: This principle impacts how officials and the media convey case information, as well as how suspects are treated during the ongoing process.

segments.src: ### 4. Pencatatan dan transparansi pemeriksaan
segments.tr: ### 4. Recording and transparency of examinations

segments.src: Salah satu topik yang kerap dibahas adalah pendokumentasian pemeriksaan, misalnya melalui rekaman.
segments.tr: One topic frequently discussed is the documentation of examinations, for example through recording.

segments.src: Dokumentasi yang baik dapat melindungi semua pihak: tersangka dari perlakuan yang tidak semestinya, dan penyidik dari tuduhan yang tidak berdasar.
segments.tr: Good documentation can protect all parties: suspects from improper treatment, and investigators from baseless accusations.

segments.src: ### 5. Kelompok rentan
segments.tr: ### 5. Vulnerable groups

segments.src: Perempuan, anak, penyandang disabilitas, dan lansia memerlukan perhatian khusus dalam proses hukum, seperti akses yang layak dan pendampingan yang sesuai.
segments.tr: Women, children, persons with disabilities, and the elderly require special attention in the legal process, such as proper access and appropriate assistance.

segments.src: Pembahasan pembaruan KUHAP juga menyentuh aspek ini.
segments.tr: The discussion on KUHAP reform also touches on this aspect.

segments.src: ### 6. Penyelesaian di luar peradilan
segments.tr: ### 6. Extrajudicial settlement

segments.src: Pendekatan keadilan restoratif, yaitu pemulihan hubungan dan kerugian korban, makin sering dibicarakan untuk perkara tertentu.
segments.tr: The restorative justice approach, namely the restoration of relationships and victims' losses, is increasingly discussed for certain cases.

segments.src: Warga perlu tahu bahwa pendekatan ini memiliki syarat dan batasan, dan tidak berlaku untuk semua jenis perkara.
segments.tr: Citizens need to know that this approach has conditions and limitations, and does not apply to all types of cases.

segments.src: ## Hak Dasar yang Perlu Anda Ketahui
segments.tr: ## Basic Rights You Need to Know

segments.src: Apa pun hasil akhir rumusan pasalnya, prinsip berikut umumnya dijunjung dalam peradilan yang adil:
segments.tr: Whatever the final outcome of the article formulation, the following principles are generally upheld in a fair trial:

segments.src: 1. **Hak diberi tahu** alasan Anda dipanggil, diperiksa, atau ditahan.
segments.tr: 1. **The right to be informed** of the reasons you are summoned, examined, or detained.

segments.src: 2. **Hak didampingi advokat** dan berkonsultasi dengan mereka.
segments.tr: 2. **The right to be accompanied by an advocate** and consult with them.

segments.src: 3. **Hak memberi keterangan secara bebas**, tanpa paksaan atau kekerasan.
segments.tr: 3. **The right to give statements freely**, without coercion or violence.

segments.src: 4. **Hak mengajukan upaya hukum**, seperti praperadilan, banding, dan seterusnya sesuai ketentuan.
segments.tr: 4. **The right to pursue legal remedies**, such as pre-trials, appeals, and so on according to provisions.

segments.src: 5. **Hak keluarga mendapat pemberitahuan** mengenai penangkapan atau penahanan.
segments.tr: 5. **The right of the family to receive notification** regarding an arrest or detention.

segments.src: ## Cara Mengikuti Perkembangannya dari Sumber Resmi
segments.tr: ## How to Follow Developments from Official Sources

segments.src: Informasi tentang hukum bergerak cepat dan mudah disalahpahami di media sosial.
segments.tr: Information about the law moves fast and is easily misunderstood on social media.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah yang bisa dilakukan:
segments.tr: Several steps that can be taken:

segments.src: - **Baca naskah resmi.** Cari peraturan dan naskah di situs resmi pemerintah seperti JDIH (Jaringan Dokumentasi dan Informasi Hukum) serta situs DPR dan Kementerian Hukum.
segments.tr: - **Read official texts.** Look for regulations and texts on official government sites such as JDIH (Legal Documentation and Information Network) as well as the websites of the DPR and the Ministry of Law.

segments.src: - **Perhatikan tanggal dan status.** Bedakan antara rancangan, naskah yang disetujui, dan undang-undang yang sudah diundangkan serta berlaku.
segments.tr: - **Pay attention to dates and status.** Distinguish between drafts, approved texts, and laws that have been promulgated and are in effect.

segments.src: - **Bandingkan beberapa sumber.** Baca laporan media yang berbeda, kajian akademisi, dan pernyataan organisasi bantuan hukum.
segments.tr: - **Compare multiple sources.** Read different media reports, academic studies, and statements from legal aid organizations.

segments.src: - **Waspadai judul sensasional.** Ringkasan satu kalimat jarang menggambarkan seluruh isi pasal.
segments.tr: - **Watch out for sensational headlines.** A one-sentence summary rarely captures the entire content of an article.

segments.src: - **Konsultasi bila perlu.** Jika Anda menghadapi perkara nyata, hubungi advokat atau lembaga bantuan hukum terdekat.
segments.tr: - **Consult if necessary.** If you face a real case, contact the nearest advocate or legal aid institution.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Pembaruan hukum acara pidana adalah isu yang menyangkut kita semua, karena siapa pun bisa berurusan dengan proses hukum sebagai saksi, korban, maupun pihak yang diperiksa.
segments.tr: Criminal procedural law reform is an issue that concerns us all, because anyone can deal with the legal process as a witness, victim, or party being examined.

segments.src: Dengan memahami hak dasar, peran para pihak, dan cara memeriksa informasi dari sumber resmi, warga dapat mengikuti perdebatan secara lebih tenang dan kritis, tanpa terjebak informasi yang keliru.
segments.tr: By understanding basic rights, the roles of the parties, and how to check information from official sources, citizens can follow the debate more calmly and critically, without being trapped by false information.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun untuk tujuan edukasi umum dan tidak menggantikan konsultasi dengan profesional hukum.*
segments.tr: *This article is prepared for general educational purposes and does not replace consultation with a legal professional.*

id-20261115-news-3.title: How to Read BI Rate Decisions: Impact on Installments, Savings, and the Rupiah

segments.src: Setiap bulan, Bank Indonesia (BI) menggelar Rapat Dewan Gubernur (RDG) dan mengumumkan arah suku bunga acuan, yaitu BI Rate.
segments.tr: Every month, Bank Indonesia (BI) holds a Board of Governors Meeting (RDG) and announces the direction of the benchmark interest rate, namely the BI Rate.

segments.src: Judul beritanya sering singkat: "BI Rate naik", "BI Rate ditahan", atau "BI Rate turun".
segments.tr: The news headlines are often brief: "BI Rate rises", "BI Rate held", or "BI Rate falls".

segments.src: Padahal, informasi yang berguna bagi rumah tangga ada di balik angka itu: alasan keputusan, pandangan BI tentang inflasi, dan sinyal untuk bulan-bulan berikutnya.
segments.tr: In fact, information useful for households lies behind those numbers: the reasons for the decision, BI's view on inflation, and signals for the coming months.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan cara membaca keputusan BI Rate dan pengaruhnya pada cicilan, tabungan, dan nilai tukar rupiah.
segments.tr: This article explains how to read BI Rate decisions and their impact on installments, savings, and the rupiah exchange rate.

segments.src: Isinya bersifat edukatif dan **bukan saran investasi atau keuangan pribadi**.
segments.tr: The content is educational and **not investment or personal financial advice**.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu BI Rate dan Siapa yang Memutuskan?
segments.tr: ## What Is the BI Rate and Who Decides It?

segments.src: BI Rate adalah suku bunga kebijakan yang mencerminkan sikap kebijakan moneter BI.
segments.tr: The BI Rate is the policy interest rate that reflects BI's monetary policy stance.

segments.src: Keputusannya diambil oleh Dewan Gubernur BI dalam RDG.
segments.tr: The decision is made by the BI Board of Governors in the RDG.

segments.src: Tujuan utama BI adalah menjaga stabilitas nilai rupiah.
segments.tr: BI's main goal is to maintain the stability of the rupiah's value.

segments.src: Stabilitas itu dilihat dari dua sisi: inflasi yang terkendali dan nilai tukar yang stabil.
segments.tr: That stability is viewed from two sides: controlled inflation and a stable exchange rate.

segments.src: BI Rate tidak langsung menjadi bunga kredit atau bunga deposito di bank Anda.
segments.tr: The BI Rate does not directly become the lending rate or deposit rate at your bank.

segments.src: Ia bekerja sebagai sinyal dan acuan bagi pasar uang.
segments.tr: It works as a signal and reference for the money market.

segments.src: Perubahannya merambat ke suku bunga lain secara bertahap, dengan kecepatan yang berbeda di tiap bank dan tiap jenis produk.
segments.tr: Its changes propagate to other interest rates gradually, at different speeds across banks and product types.

segments.src: ## Tiga Hal yang Perlu Dibaca dari Pengumuman RDG
segments.tr: ## Three Things to Read from the RDG Announcement

segments.src: ### 1. Arah keputusan: naik, tetap, atau turun
segments.tr: ### 1. Direction of the decision: up, unchanged, or down

segments.src: - **Naik**: biasanya untuk menahan inflasi atau menjaga rupiah dari tekanan. Biaya pinjaman cenderung naik dan konsumsi melambat.
segments.tr: - **Up**: usually to curb inflation or protect the rupiah from pressure. Borrowing costs tend to rise and consumption slows down.

segments.src: - **Tetap**: BI menilai kondisi sudah sesuai target, atau masih menunggu data tambahan.
segments.tr: - **Unchanged**: BI assesses that conditions are on target, or is still waiting for additional data.

segments.src: - **Turun**: biasanya untuk mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi saat inflasi terkendali dan tekanan pada rupiah mereda.
segments.tr: - **Down**: usually to encourage economic growth when inflation is controlled and pressure on the rupiah eases.

segments.src: ### 2. Alasan dan bahasa yang dipakai
segments.tr: ### 2. Reasons and language used

segments.src: Kalimat dalam rilis resmi sering lebih informatif daripada angkanya.
segments.tr: Sentences in official releases are often more informative than the numbers.

segments.src: Perhatikan beberapa hal berikut:
segments.tr: Pay attention to the following:

segments.src: - Apakah BI menyebut inflasi **inti** (core inflation) masih di dalam sasaran? Inflasi inti lebih mencerminkan tekanan harga yang bersifat menetap.
segments.tr: - Does BI mention that **core inflation** is still within target? Core inflation better reflects persistent price pressures.

segments.src: - Apakah BI menyoroti **ketidakpastian global**, misalnya arah suku bunga bank sentral Amerika Serikat atau pergerakan dolar AS?
segments.tr: - Does BI highlight **global uncertainty**, such as the interest rate direction of the United States central bank or the movement of the US dollar?

segments.src: - Apakah BI menyebut **stabilitas rupiah** sebagai prioritas dalam keputusan kali ini?
segments.tr: - Does BI mention **rupiah stability** as a priority in this decision?

segments.src: - Apakah kalimatnya menunjukkan sikap hati-hati (*cautious*), longgar (*accommodative*), atau ketat (*tight*)?
segments.tr: - Do the sentences show a cautious (*cautious*), accommodative (*accommodative*), or tight (*tight*) stance?

segments.src: Perubahan kecil pada pilihan kata dari satu bulan ke bulan berikutnya sering menjadi petunjuk arah kebijakan ke depan.
segments.tr: Small changes in word choice from one month to the next often serve as clues for future policy direction.

segments.src: ### 3. Data pendukung
segments.tr: ### 3. Supporting data

segments.src: Sebelum rapat, pasar biasanya memperhatikan beberapa data yang dirilis Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) dan BI sendiri:
segments.tr: Before the meeting, the market usually pays attention to several data releases by Statistics Indonesia (BPS) and BI itself:

segments.src: - Inflasi tahunan dan bulanan
segments.tr: - Annual and monthly inflation

segments.src: - Kurs rupiah terhadap dolar AS
segments.tr: - Rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar

segments.src: - Pertumbuhan kredit perbankan
segments.tr: - Bank credit growth

segments.src: - Neraca perdagangan dan cadangan devisa
segments.tr: - Trade balance and foreign exchange reserves

segments.src: Anda bisa membaca data-data ini di situs resmi BPS dan BI untuk memahami konteks sebelum keputusan diumumkan.
segments.tr: You can read this data on the official BPS and BI websites to understand the context before decisions are announced.

segments.src: ## Hubungan BI Rate dengan Inflasi dan Kurs
segments.tr: ## The Relationship Between the BI Rate, Inflation, and the Exchange Rate

segments.src: Bayangkan suku bunga sebagai "pedal rem dan gas" ekonomi.
segments.tr: Imagine interest rates as the economy's "brake and gas pedals".

segments.src: - Saat inflasi naik terlalu cepat, BI dapat menaikkan suku bunga. Pinjaman menjadi lebih mahal, permintaan melambat, dan tekanan harga berkurang.
segments.tr: - When inflation rises too fast, BI can raise interest rates. Loans become more expensive, demand slows, and price pressures ease.

segments.src: - Suku bunga yang lebih menarik juga dapat membuat aset rupiah lebih diminati investor, sehingga membantu menopang nilai tukar.
segments.tr: - More attractive interest rates can also make rupiah assets more appealing to investors, helping to support the exchange rate.

segments.src: - Saat inflasi rendah dan ekonomi perlu dorongan, BI memiliki ruang untuk menurunkan suku bunga.
segments.tr: - When inflation is low and the economy needs a boost, BI has room to lower interest rates.

segments.src: Hubungan ini tidak selalu satu arah.
segments.tr: This relationship is not always one-way.

segments.src: Kurs rupiah dipengaruhi banyak faktor lain, seperti kebijakan bank sentral negara besar, harga komoditas, arus modal asing, dan sentimen global.
segments.tr: The rupiah exchange rate is influenced by many other factors, such as major central bank policies, commodity prices, foreign capital flows, and global sentiment.

segments.src: Karena itu, perubahan BI Rate tidak otomatis menguatkan atau melemahkan rupiah dalam waktu singkat.
segments.tr: Therefore, changes in the BI Rate do not automatically strengthen or weaken the rupiah in a short time.

segments.src: ## Dampaknya bagi Rumah Tangga
segments.tr: ## Impact on Households

segments.src: ### Cicilan kredit
segments.tr: ### Credit installments

segments.src: - **Kredit dengan bunga mengambang (floating)**, seperti sebagian KPR, dapat ikut berubah setelah masa bunga tetap berakhir. Besarnya perubahan bergantung pada kebijakan bank dan isi perjanjian kredit.
segments.tr: - **Floating-rate loans**, such as some mortgages, may change after the fixed-rate period ends. The magnitude of the change depends on bank policy and the credit agreement.

segments.src: - **Kredit dengan bunga tetap (fixed)** tidak langsung berubah selama periode bunga tetap berlaku, tetapi akan terdampak saat masa itu selesai atau saat Anda mengajukan kredit baru.
segments.tr: - **Fixed-rate loans** do not change immediately while the fixed rate applies, but will be affected when that period ends or when you apply for a new loan.

segments.src: - Kartu kredit dan pinjaman tanpa agunan umumnya memiliki bunga tinggi yang tidak terlalu sensitif terhadap perubahan kecil BI Rate. Tetap utamakan membayar penuh tagihan tepat waktu.
segments.tr: - Credit cards and unsecured loans generally have high interest rates that are not very sensitive to small changes in the BI Rate. Always prioritize paying your bill in full and on time.

segments.src: Cek dokumen perjanjian kredit Anda: apakah bunganya tetap atau mengambang, kapan masa bunga tetap berakhir, dan apakah ada biaya pelunasan dipercepat.
segments.tr: Check your credit agreement documents: whether the interest rate is fixed or floating, when the fixed rate period ends, and whether there are early repayment fees.

segments.src: ### Tabungan dan deposito
segments.tr: ### Savings and deposits

segments.src: Bunga deposito cenderung bergerak mengikuti suku bunga acuan, tetapi tidak selalu serempak.
segments.tr: Deposit interest rates tend to follow the benchmark rate, but not always simultaneously.

segments.src: Bank juga mempertimbangkan kebutuhan likuiditas dan persaingan antarbank.
segments.tr: Banks also consider liquidity needs and interbank competition.

segments.src: Hal yang perlu diingat:
segments.tr: Things to keep in mind:

segments.src: - Bandingkan bunga dari beberapa bank, bukan hanya dari satu bank.
segments.tr: - Compare interest rates from multiple banks, not just one.

segments.src: - Perhatikan pajak atas bunga deposito dan ketentuan pencairan sebelum jatuh tempo.
segments.tr: - Pay attention to taxes on deposit interest and withdrawal terms before maturity.

segments.src: - Pastikan simpanan berada di bank yang dijamin Lembaga Penjamin Simpanan (LPS) dan perhatikan batas jaminan serta tingkat bunga penjaminan yang berlaku.
segments.tr: - Ensure savings are held in banks insured by the Deposit Insurance Corporation (LPS) and pay attention to guarantee limits and applicable guaranteed interest rates.

segments.src: ### Rupiah dan harga barang
segments.tr: ### The Rupiah and goods prices

segments.src: Rupiah yang melemah dapat menaikkan harga barang impor dan bahan baku, termasuk gadget, sebagian bahan pangan, dan biaya perjalanan ke luar negeri.
segments.tr: A weakening rupiah can raise the prices of imported goods and raw materials, including gadgets, some food items, and overseas travel costs.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, rupiah yang stabil membantu menjaga harga tetap terkendali.
segments.tr: Conversely, a stable rupiah helps keep prices controlled.

segments.src: Jika Anda punya rencana belanja besar dalam mata uang asing, seperti sekolah atau wisata ke luar negeri, pantau tren kurs dan siapkan dana secara bertahap, bukan sekaligus.
segments.tr: If you have major spending plans in foreign currency, such as schooling or traveling abroad, monitor exchange rate trends and prepare funds gradually rather than all at once.

segments.src: ## Langkah Praktis Setelah RDG Diumumkan
segments.tr: ## Practical Steps After the RDG Is Announced

segments.src: 1. **Baca rilis resmi BI**, bukan hanya judul berita. Rilis tersedia di situs resmi BI.
segments.tr: 1. **Read the official BI release**, not just the news headlines. The release is available on the official BI website.

segments.src: 2. **Catat alasan keputusan** dan perubahan bahasa dibanding bulan lalu.
segments.tr: 2. **Note the reasons for the decision** and changes in language compared to last month.

segments.src: 3. **Tinjau kewajiban Anda**: cicilan, jenis bunga, dan sisa tenor.
segments.tr: 3. **Review your obligations**: installments, interest types, and remaining tenor.

segments.src: 4. **Tinjau dana darurat**: idealnya setara beberapa bulan pengeluaran dan disimpan di instrumen yang mudah dicairkan.
segments.tr: 4. **Review your emergency fund**: ideally equivalent to several months of expenses and kept in easily liquidatable instruments.

segments.src: 5. **Hindari keputusan impulsif.** Satu keputusan BI Rate jarang mengubah rencana keuangan jangka panjang. Yang lebih penting adalah tren beberapa bulan dan kondisi keuangan Anda sendiri.
segments.tr: 5. **Avoid impulsive decisions.** A single BI Rate decision rarely changes long-term financial plans. What matters more is the trend over several months and your own financial condition.

segments.src: ## Kesalahan Umum dalam Membaca BI Rate
segments.tr: ## Common Mistakes in Reading the BI Rate

segments.src: - **Menganggap bunga kredit langsung ikut berubah.** Penyesuaian di bank bisa tertunda atau berbeda besarnya.
segments.tr: - **Assuming lending rates change immediately.** Adjustments at banks can be delayed or differ in magnitude.

segments.src: - **Menganggap kurs pasti bereaksi sesuai harapan.** Faktor global sering lebih dominan dalam jangka pendek.
segments.tr: - **Assuming the exchange rate will definitely react as expected.** Global factors are often more dominant in the short term.

segments.src: - **Hanya melihat angka tanpa konteks.** Penahanan suku bunga bisa berarti "stabil", tetapi bisa juga menandakan sikap waspada.
segments.tr: - **Looking only at numbers without context.** Holding interest rates steady can mean "stable", but it can also signal a cautious stance.

segments.src: - **Mengandalkan rumor atau prediksi yang tidak jelas sumbernya.** Gunakan sumber resmi dan media tepercaya.
segments.tr: - **Relying on rumors or predictions from unclear sources.** Use official sources and trusted media.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Keputusan BI Rate adalah potret cara bank sentral menilai inflasi, rupiah, dan pertumbuhan ekonomi.
segments.tr: BI Rate decisions are a snapshot of how the central bank assesses inflation, the rupiah, and economic growth.

segments.src: Dengan membaca alasan di balik angkanya, Anda bisa memahami arah ekonomi dan menyiapkan keuangan rumah tangga dengan lebih tenang.
segments.tr: By reading the reasons behind the numbers, you can understand economic directions and prepare household finances more calmly.

segments.src: Tidak ada rumus tunggal yang cocok untuk semua orang, jadi sesuaikan langkah Anda dengan kondisi pribadi.
segments.tr: There is no single formula that suits everyone, so adjust your steps to your personal circumstances.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bertujuan memberi pemahaman umum.
segments.tr: *Note: This article aims to provide general understanding.

segments.src: Besaran suku bunga dan kebijakan dapat berubah, sehingga selalu rujuk pengumuman resmi Bank Indonesia dan konsultasikan kebutuhan spesifik Anda dengan perencana keuangan atau bank yang berizin dan diawasi OJK.*
segments.tr: Interest rates and policies may change, so always refer to official Bank Indonesia announcements and consult your specific needs with a financial planner or a bank licensed and supervised by the OJK.*

id-20261115-consumer-advertising-psychol.title: [Consumer Psychology #6] Why Scary Cigarette Ads and Funny Instant Noodle Ads Can Both Persuade You?

segments.src: > Iklan membujuk lewat dua "jalur" di kepala kita: jalur yang memikirkan isi pesan dan jalur yang menangkap sinyal sampingan. Rasa takut dan humor bisa membantu, asal takarannya pas.
segments.tr: > Ads persuade through two "routes" in our minds: the route that thinks about the message content and the route that catches side signals. Fear and humor can help, as long as the dose is right.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Setiap hari kita melihat ratusan iklan: di YouTube, Instagram, baliho di pinggir jalan tol, sampai bungkus rokok.
segments.tr: Every day we see hundreds of ads: on YouTube, Instagram, billboards along the toll road, even cigarette packs.

segments.src: Sebagian besar langsung kita lupakan, tapi ada beberapa yang benar-benar mengubah pikiran atau membuat kita membeli sesuatu.
segments.tr: Most are forgotten right away, but some really change our minds or make us buy something.

segments.src: Apa bedanya?
segments.tr: What's the difference?

segments.src: Psikologi konsumen punya beberapa alat untuk menjelaskannya.
segments.tr: Consumer psychology has several tools to explain it.

segments.src: Hari ini kita bahas tiga: **ELM**, **daya tarik rasa takut (fear appeal)**, dan **daya tarik humor (humor appeal)**.
segments.tr: Today we cover three: **ELM**, **fear appeal**, and **humor appeal**.

segments.src: ### 1. Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM)
segments.tr: ### 1. Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM)

segments.src: ELM dikembangkan oleh Richard Petty dan John Cacioppo pada 1980-an.
segments.tr: ELM was developed by Richard Petty and John Cacioppo in the 1980s.

segments.src: Idenya sederhana: ketika menerima pesan persuasif, kita bisa memprosesnya lewat dua jalur.
segments.tr: The idea is simple: when receiving a persuasive message, we can process it through two routes.

segments.src: - **Jalur sentral (central route)**: kita benar-benar memikirkan isi pesan. Apakah argumennya masuk akal? Apakah datanya kuat? Jalur ini dipakai saat kita **termotivasi** (topiknya penting bagi kita) dan **mampu** (punya waktu, fokus, dan pengetahuan).
segments.tr: - **Central route**: we really think about the message content. Does the argument make sense? Is the data strong? This route is used when we are **motivated** (the topic matters to us) and **able** (we have time, focus, and knowledge).

segments.src: - **Jalur periferal (peripheral route)**: kita tidak menelaah isi pesan secara mendalam, melainkan terpengaruh oleh petunjuk sampingan, misalnya artis terkenal, musik yang enak, jumlah testimoni, atau desain yang menarik.
segments.tr: - **Peripheral route**: we don't scrutinize the message content in depth, but are influenced by side cues, such as famous artists, catchy music, number of testimonials, or attractive design.

segments.src: Kata kuncinya adalah **elaborasi**, yaitu seberapa dalam kita memikirkan pesan.
segments.tr: The key word is **elaboration**, meaning how deeply we think about the message.

segments.src: Elaborasi tinggi berarti jalur sentral, elaborasi rendah berarti jalur periferal.
segments.tr: High elaboration means the central route, low elaboration means the peripheral route.

segments.src: Kenapa ini penting?
segments.tr: Why does this matter?

segments.src: Penelitian menunjukkan bahwa perubahan sikap lewat jalur sentral cenderung **lebih tahan lama** dan lebih tahan terhadap bujukan tandingan.
segments.tr: Research shows that attitude change via the central route tends to be **more durable** and more resistant to counter-persuasion.

segments.src: Perubahan lewat jalur periferal biasanya lebih cepat tapi juga lebih cepat pudar.
segments.tr: Change via the peripheral route is usually faster but also fades faster.

segments.src: ### 2. Fear Appeal: Menakut-nakuti dengan Tujuan
segments.tr: ### 2. Fear Appeal: Scaring with a Purpose

segments.src: Fear appeal adalah pesan yang menunjukkan akibat buruk jika kita tidak melakukan (atau terus melakukan) sesuatu.
segments.tr: A fear appeal is a message showing the bad consequences if we don't do (or keep doing) something.

segments.src: Contoh: peringatan bergambar di bungkus rokok, iklan keselamatan berkendara, atau iklan asuransi.
segments.tr: Examples: graphic warnings on cigarette packs, road safety ads, or insurance ads.

segments.src: Apakah menakut-nakuti efektif?
segments.tr: Is scaring effective?

segments.src: Jawabannya: **bisa, dengan syarat**.
segments.tr: Answer: **it can, under conditions**.

segments.src: Menurut model yang banyak dipakai (misalnya Extended Parallel Process Model dari Kim Witte), rasa takut hanya mendorong tindakan jika dua hal terpenuhi:
segments.tr: According to widely used models (for example the Extended Parallel Process Model by Kim Witte), fear only drives action if two things are met:

segments.src: 1. **Ancamannya terasa nyata dan relevan** bagi saya.
segments.tr: 1. **The threat feels real and relevant** to me.

segments.src: 2. **Ada solusi yang jelas dan saya merasa mampu melakukannya** (efikasi).
segments.tr: 2. **There is a clear solution and I feel able to do it** (efficacy).

segments.src: Kalau ancaman besar tapi solusinya tidak jelas, orang cenderung **menghindar**: memalingkan muka, menyangkal ("ah, kakek saya merokok sampai umur 90"), atau mengabaikan pesan.
segments.tr: If the threat is big but the solution is unclear, people tend to **avoid**: looking away, denying ("ah, my grandfather smoked until 90"), or ignoring the message.

segments.src: Jadi, pesan menakutkan sebaiknya selalu ditutup dengan "ini yang bisa Anda lakukan".
segments.tr: So a scary message should always end with "this is what you can do".

segments.src: ### 3. Humor Appeal: Membuat Tertawa, Lalu?
segments.tr: ### 3. Humor Appeal: Making People Laugh, Then What?

segments.src: Humor membuat iklan lebih **diperhatikan** dan lebih **disukai**.
segments.tr: Humor makes ads more **noticed** and more **liked**.

segments.src: Orang juga senang membagikan iklan lucu di media sosial.
segments.tr: People also like sharing funny ads on social media.

segments.src: Tapi ada catatan penting:
segments.tr: But there is an important caveat:

segments.src: - Humor sering bekerja lewat **jalur periferal**: kita suka iklannya, lalu sikap positif itu ikut menempel ke merek.
segments.tr: - Humor often works via the **peripheral route**: we like the ad, and that positive feeling sticks to the brand.

segments.src: - Risikonya: penonton ingat leluconnya tapi **lupa mereknya** atau lupa pesannya. Ini kadang disebut efek *vampire*, karena unsur kreatif "menyedot" perhatian dari produk.
segments.tr: - The risk: viewers remember the joke but **forget the brand** or forget the message. This is sometimes called the *vampire* effect, because the creative element "sucks" attention away from the product.

segments.src: - Humor lebih cocok untuk produk berisiko rendah dan sehari-hari (camilan, minuman, aplikasi) dibanding produk serius yang butuh pertimbangan matang (asuransi jiwa, kredit rumah, obat).
segments.tr: - Humor suits low-risk, everyday products (snacks, drinks, apps) better than serious products that need careful consideration (life insurance, home loans, medicine).

segments.src: - Humor yang paling efektif biasanya **terkait langsung dengan manfaat produk**, bukan sekadar lelucon tempelan.
segments.tr: - Humor works best when it is **directly tied to the product's benefits**, not just a tacked-on joke.

segments.src: ## Di Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Dimas, karyawan muda di Jakarta, sedang menggulir TikTok sambil menunggu KRL di Stasiun Manggarai.
segments.tr: Imagine Dimas, a young office worker in Jakarta, scrolling TikTok while waiting for the KRL at Manggarai Station.

segments.src: Dalam lima menit ia melihat tiga iklan:
segments.tr: In five minutes he sees three ads:

segments.src: 1. **Iklan minuman dalam kemasan** seharga Rp5.000-an dengan sketsa lucu tentang orang kepanasan di macet. Dimas tertawa, tidak berpikir panjang, dan sorenya membeli minuman itu di minimarket. Ini contoh **jalur periferal + humor**: produknya murah, risikonya kecil, jadi tidak perlu dipikir dalam-dalam.
segments.tr: 1. **A packaged drink ad** priced around Rp5,000 with a funny sketch about people overheating in traffic. Dimas laughs, doesn't think much, and that evening buys that drink at a minimarket. This is an example of **peripheral route + humor**: the product is cheap, the risk is small, so it doesn't need deep thought.

segments.src: 2. **Iklan kampanye keselamatan** tentang pengendara motor tanpa helm yang kecelakaan. Gambarnya seram. Di akhir iklan muncul pesan "Pakai helm SNI, kunci talinya. Butuh 5 detik." Karena ancamannya relevan (Dimas naik ojek online setiap hari) dan solusinya sangat mudah, pesan ini lebih mungkin mengubah perilakunya. Inilah **fear appeal yang dilengkapi efikasi**.
segments.tr: 2. **A road safety campaign** about motorcyclists without helmets who crash. The images are frightening. At the end the message appears: "Wear an SNI helmet, buckle the strap. Takes 5 seconds." Because the threat is relevant (Dimas takes an online ojek every day) and the solution is very easy, this message is more likely to change his behavior. This is **fear appeal complemented by efficacy**.

segments.src: 3. **Iklan KPR** yang membandingkan cicilan, bunga, dan tenor. Dimas sedang menabung untuk rumah pertama di Bekasi, jadi ia menonton sampai habis, bahkan membuka situs bank untuk membandingkan simulasi cicilan. Ini **jalur sentral**: motivasinya tinggi, jadi kualitas argumen yang menentukan.
segments.tr: 3. **A mortgage (KPR) ad** comparing installments, interest, and tenor. Dimas is saving for a first home in Bekasi, so he watches to the end and even opens the bank's website to compare installment simulations. This is the **central route**: his motivation is high, so the quality of the argument decides.

segments.src: Perhatikan: kalau iklan KPR itu hanya berisi artis yang tersenyum tanpa informasi bunga, Dimas justru bisa curiga.
segments.tr: Notice: if that mortgage ad only showed an artist smiling with no interest information, Dimas might actually become suspicious.

segments.src: Strategi yang tepat bergantung pada **siapa penontonnya dan seberapa penting keputusannya**.
segments.tr: The right strategy depends on **who the audience is and how important the decision is**.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Menurut ELM, pesan persuasif diproses lewat **jalur sentral** (memikirkan isi argumen) atau **jalur periferal** (terpengaruh petunjuk sampingan), tergantung motivasi dan kemampuan penonton.
segments.tr: 1. According to ELM, persuasive messages are processed via the **central route** (thinking about argument content) or the **peripheral route** (influenced by side cues), depending on the audience's motivation and ability.

segments.src: 2. **Fear appeal** efektif jika ancamannya terasa relevan **dan** ada solusi jelas yang terasa mudah dilakukan; tanpa solusi, orang cenderung menghindar.
segments.tr: 2. **Fear appeal** is effective when the threat feels relevant **and** there is a clear solution that feels easy to do; without a solution, people tend to avoid.

segments.src: 3. **Humor appeal** menarik perhatian dan rasa suka, tetapi bisa membuat merek dilupakan; paling cocok untuk produk berisiko rendah dan bila leluconnya terkait dengan manfaat produk.
segments.tr: 3. **Humor appeal** attracts attention and liking, but can make the brand forgotten; it is best for low-risk products and when the joke relates to the product's benefits.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM)**: model yang menjelaskan bahwa persuasi bisa terjadi lewat jalur sentral atau periferal, tergantung seberapa dalam pesan dipikirkan.
segments.tr: - **Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM)**: a model explaining that persuasion can occur via the central or peripheral route, depending on how deeply the message is thought through.

segments.src: - **Jalur sentral**: pemrosesan pesan dengan menimbang kualitas argumen secara cermat; perubahan sikapnya cenderung lebih tahan lama.
segments.tr: - **Central route**: processing a message by carefully weighing argument quality; attitude change tends to be more durable.

segments.src: - **Jalur periferal**: pemrosesan pesan berdasarkan petunjuk sampingan seperti selebritas, musik, atau tampilan.
segments.tr: - **Peripheral route**: processing a message based on side cues such as celebrities, music, or appearance.

segments.src: - **Fear appeal**: pesan yang membangkitkan rasa takut terhadap akibat buruk untuk mendorong perubahan perilaku.
segments.tr: - **Fear appeal**: a message that arouses fear of bad consequences to encourage behavior change.

segments.src: - **Efikasi**: keyakinan bahwa solusi yang ditawarkan berhasil dan bahwa diri kita mampu melakukannya.
segments.tr: - **Efficacy**: the belief that the offered solution works and that we are capable of doing it.

segments.src: Keputusannya penting dan ia punya motivasi tinggi, jadi ia menimbang argumen (jalur sentral).
segments.tr: The decision is important and they are highly motivated, so they weigh the arguments (central route).

segments.src: Rasa takut tanpa solusi yang jelas dan mudah justru bisa memicu penyangkalan atau penghindaran.
segments.tr: Fear without a clear, easy solution can actually trigger denial or avoidance.

segments.src: Humor bisa "mencuri" perhatian dari produk sehingga penonton mengingat leluconnya, bukan mereknya.*
segments.tr: Humor can "steal" attention from the product so the audience remembers the joke, not the brand.*
